items.exampleEn: A big lorry was blocking the road.
items.exampleZh: 一輛大卡車擋住了馬路。

items.exampleEn: Backpacking is a cheap way to see the world.
items.exampleZh: 背包旅行是看世界的便宜方式。

items.exampleEn: The check-in counter was very busy this morning.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上報到櫃台非常忙。

items.exampleEn: The hotel check-in desk opens at two.
items.exampleZh: 飯店的入住櫃台兩點開放。
items.glossZh: （飯店、機場的）報到櫃台；入住櫃台

items.exampleEn: Public transport in this city is fast and cheap.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市的大眾運輸又快又便宜。

items.exampleEn: Traffic jams are common here in the morning.
Her mother works as a travel agent.

items.sentenceEn: The lorry driver stopped for a coffee.
items.sentenceZh: 卡車司機停下來喝杯咖啡。

items.audioEn: Sorry I'm late. There was a traffic jam on the bridge.
items.audioZh: 抱歉我遲到了。橋上塞車。
options: Too many cars on the bridge

items.sentenceEn: Ask at the check-in desk if you need a taxi.
items.sentenceZh: 如果需要計程車，可以問入住櫃台。

items.sentenceEn: Many students go backpacking after they finish school.
items.sentenceZh: 很多學生畢業後會去背包旅行。

items.stemEn: The ____ helped us plan our whole holiday.
items.stemZh: 旅行社人員幫我們規劃了整個假期。

items.stemEn: At the airport, show your passport at the ____.
items.stemZh: 在機場時，請在報到櫃台出示護照。

items.passageEn: My travel agent found a cheap flight for my backpacking trip. On the day of the trip, I took public transport to the airport because parking there is expensive. But the bus got stuck in a traffic jam behind a lorry that had broken down near the crossroads. I ran to the check-in counter just ten minutes before it closed. Next time, I will leave home much earlier.
items.passageZh: 旅行社的人幫我這趟背包旅行找到便宜的機票。出發那天，我搭大眾運輸去機場，因為那裡停車很貴。但公車在十字路口附近，被困在一輛故障卡車後面的車陣裡。我跑到報到櫃台時，離櫃台關閉只剩十分鐘。下次我會更早出門。

questions.questionZh: 公車為什麼被困在車陣中？
作者趕到報到櫃台時是什麼情況？

items.promptZh: 我們在飯店的入住櫃台等了二十分鐘。
referenceEn: We waited at the hotel check-in desk for twenty minutes.
We waited for twenty minutes at the check-in desk of the hotel.
rubricZh: check-in desk 表示「入住櫃台、報到櫃台」
「等了二十分鐘」寫法例如 waited for twenty minutes、waited twenty minutes 等
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 如果你沒有車，搭大眾運輸去那裡也很方便。
referenceEn: If you don't have a car, it is easy to get there by public transport.
Without a car, you can still get there easily by public transport.
rubricZh: 用 public transport 表示「大眾運輸」（例如 by public transport；寫 public transportation 也正確）
「很方便」可寫，例如 it is easy to、easily 等
